title: Sign in with ChatGPT
description: Manage separate ChatGPT connections for Cognia.
isolation: These connections are separate from your existing subscriptions, accounts, and defaults. Tokens stay on this device and are excluded from subscription backups and sync.
desktopOnly: Sign in with ChatGPT requires the desktop app.
locked: Unlock a local Cognia account to manage ChatGPT connections.
operationFailed: The operation could not be completed. Reload connections or try signing in again.
signedIn: ChatGPT connection added. Existing accounts and defaults are unchanged.
planUnavailable: This connection does not currently grant ChatGPT plan usage. Sign in again and allow plan access before using it for inference.
removeAfterSignOut: Sign out before removing this registration.
signedOut: Signed out locally and remote token revocation was confirmed.
revocationUnconfirmed: Signed out on this device. Remote revocation could not be confirmed; review connected apps in your ChatGPT account if needed.
noModels: No models are available for this connection.
chatConfigured: Chat connection added. Select it explicitly when starting a conversation.
agentConfigured: App-server configuration added in a disabled state. Enable it in Agents, then select it explicitly when starting an agent conversation.
selectionHelp: Adding a configuration does not select it, change your default, or enable billing fallback to another account.
editorConnectionHint: This agent uses its separate ChatGPT connection and device-local state. Manage sign-in in Account Center; the native host controls its command and credentials.
removeDescription: Remove this signed-out connection from this device. Existing subscriptions, other registrations, and account defaults are unchanged.
